hero.subtitle: AI-driven IT asset management: one live view of every hardware and software asset, mapped to entitlements, contracts and spend.

challenge.title: Why it matters in the Kingdom
challenge.body: NCA ECC (2-1) and SAMA's cyber framework require an accurate, current inventory of technology assets, and EXPRO is driving spending efficiency across government.
points: An accurate, current inventory of technology assets
License compliance risk before a vendor audit
Unused licenses and renewals that are not right-sized

opportunity.title: One platform delivers both
opportunity.body: Audit-ready asset records and measurable IT savings. The platform flags compliance risk before a vendor audit does, and turns insight into savings by reclaiming unused licenses and right-sizing renewals.

capabilities.title: Discover & normalize
capabilities.body: Automated discovery of hardware, software and connected assets into one clean inventory.

capabilities.title: Map entitlements
capabilities.body: Licenses, contracts and renewals matched to what is actually deployed and used.

capabilities.title: Review compliance
capabilities.body: Continuous license-position checks flag risk before a vendor audit does.

capabilities.title: Optimize spend
capabilities.body: Reclaim unused licenses, right-size renewals and cut waste, with the reasoning shown.
